ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic screening standards: All beneficial owners, directors, officers, and registered agents must be screened against the U.S. OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the global INTERPOL and EU restricted lists, the Panamanian Public Registry's restricted list of professional service providers, and the national PEP database maintained under Ley 23 of 2015. Prior to incorporation and during ongoing compliance, the registered agent must obtain a negative sanctions-screening report from a qualified compliance firm, including PEP status classification (foreign PEP, domestic PEP, immediate family/close associate) and enhanced due diligence for higher-risk profiles. For this entity, the AML risk tier is 'Low_Risk_Standard' due to the AI subtitling and dubbing studio model and non-financial payment rails; nevertheless, the statutory protocols are respaldo mandatory.

The name must include a denominação type or abbreviation (

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this non-licensed AI services industry, the use of a registered agent's address as the registered/statutory office is deemed fully permissible, including virtual office arrangements. The statutory mandate is satisfied by appointing a Panama-law-qualified registered agent (abogado idóneo) who maintains a physical address in Panama. No material physical presence, employees, or equipment is required for incorporation under Panamanian law; however, if generating meaningful local income or concluding government contracts, the company must hold economic substance documentation (invoicing, accounting records, minutes) at the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_Risk: quantified at 5% annual probability for an AI subtitle production studio with digital/remote operations, absent financial licensing, real-estate holdings, or significant local contracting. If the company later engages in activities requiring a municipal license (Aviso de Operación) or obtains a special economic regime registration, the likelihood increases to 20%. The Public Registry does not perform unannounced physical inspections except in AML investigations, fraud referrals, or where a compliance authority requests verification of the registered office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas — Ley 32 de 1927, as amended; Articles 1–19 (incorporation), 27–32 (capital and shares), 33–41 (registered agent and registered office), 42–53 (directors and officers); supplemented by the Código de Comercio Book I and the mercantile registration regulations of the Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (Mercantile Registry Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima / Pacto Social
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; common practice sets authorized capital at US$10,000; no escrow account or paid-in deposit is mandated for founding a Sociedad Anónima under Ley 32 de 1927.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [CORPORATE NAME], S.A. 1. RESOLVED that the share subscription, paid-up capital and subscriber allotments stated in the Articles of Incorporation are approved, and share certificates are authorized for execution and delivery. 2. RESOLVED that the registered office is adopted and the Registered Agent accepting service of process is ratified. 3. RESOLVED that [Name], President/CEO; [Name], Secretary; and [Name], Treasurer, be appointed with full authority to open bank accounts, sign contracts and direct regulatory filings. 4. RESOLVED that counsel shall procure the RUC, municipal operating license, and all licenses necessary for automated subtitle and AI dubbing operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Nombre Availability Desk (in-person or online at www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a written request listing up to three preferred corporate names for the Sociedad Anónima. Pay the official name search fee at the cashier or via the online payment gateway and obtain the reservation certificate. The reservation is valid for 60 days and must be used in the subsequent notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Letter of application signed by each founding subscriber
Passport or identity-card copies of shareholders and directors
List of up to three proposed corporate names in order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration, cure the rejection by submitting a new request containing alternative names; if the reservation expires before use, file a written extension request or re-apply and pay the corresponding fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de Panamá (Notary of the Circuit for the company domicile)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the reserved-name certificate, the draft Pacto Social and the registered agent's acceptance letter to the notary. All founding shareholders must appear personally or by attorney-in-fact before the notary, declare the corporate object (ISIC 5912 — automated subtitle transcription, post-production, AI voice-cloning and dubbing services), capital structure, registered office, registered agent and board of directors. The notary authenticates the deed and issues the first certified copy for registry inscription.
required_dossiers: Corporate name reservation certificate
Draft Escritura Pública / Pacto Social
Registered agent acceptance letter with address for service of process
Passport or identity-card copies and proof of domicile of subscribers
Board authorization instruments if any subscriber is a corporate entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a subscriber fails to appear or a formal omission is detected, adjourn the signing or execute a supplementary notarial act; material errors are cured by a new mutual consent deed executed before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Public Deed in the Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the certified first-notarial copy of the Escritura Pública to the Mercantile Section together with the registration application form and the treasury receipt for official fees computed on authorized capital. Await inscription, then request the Certificado de Persona Jurídica (Corporate Certificate) evidencing legal existence, corporate number and registered data of the S.A.
required_dossiers: Certified first-notarial copy of the Public Deed
Registration application form (Formulario de Presentación)
Payment receipt of official registry fees
Certified copy of the registered agent appointment where not merged in the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration officer issues an 'observación' or formal query, cure the specific defect and re-present the same deed within five business days; if the deed is inscribed with substantive errors, apply to the registry for rectification or execute a notarial amendment deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Municipal and Operational Licensing Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DIGI/MEF) and Municipio de Panamá – Subdirección de Avisos y Patentes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the registered deed and corporate certificate, enroll the S.A. in the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) through the DIGI tax portal, submit the commencement-of-operations sworn statement, and obtain the company tax identification number. Then file for the municipal Aviso de Operación (municipal operation notice) for the office used as the AI post-production studio, mapping the business activity to ISIC 5912, and enroll for ITBMS where taxable operations commence.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Persona Jurídica issued by the Public Registry
Certified copy of the registered public deed
Board resolution appointing the fiscal/legal representative
RUC application form with identity documents of the representative
Lease agreement or title deed evidencing the registered office and studio address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIGI requires supplemental proof of domicile or corporate data, file the corrected lease/power and amended application; if the municipality questions land use, obtain the Uso de Suelo certificate and correct the declared activity code to ISIC 5912.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security Employer Enrollment and Statutory Books Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) – Dirección de Afiliación y Registro; Registro Público de Panamá (Books and Records Desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. as an employer before the CSS, obtain the employer contribution account, and enroll any hired staff in the social security system. Prepare and present the corporate statutory books (share register, minutes book and accounting records) at the Public Registry for stamping and legalization as required for commencement of operations.
required_dossiers: Corporate certificate and RUC registration
Employer registration form (Formulario de Inscripción del Empleador)
Board resolution confirming payroll and accounting officers
ITBMS/VAT enrollment receipt where applicable
Statutory corporate minute book and share register for legalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CSS form is returned for defects, resubmit the corrected employer form with certified S.A. registry data; missing book stamps are cured by re-presentation of the volumes after the corporate certificate is re-issued or updated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Non-industrial digital service activity — general commercial licensing authority is the Municipio de Panamá, Subdirección de Avisos y Patentes; the Ministry of Commerce and Industries is not engaged for manufacturing permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación Comercial / Municipal Operation Notice (not an industrial operating permit)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III (Bajo Impacto Ambiental) — environmental registration/declaration before MiAMBIENTE; full EIA Study (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) is not required for software, IT, subtitle transcription and AI dubbing studio services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process water, industrial wastewater or point-source atmospheric emissions are generated by the activity; comply with municipal solid-waste collection rules for office waste, electronic-waste handling provisions for IT equipment, and occupational indoor-air/VOC exposure thresholds under Panamanian workplace hygiene regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-prevention inspection and certificate from the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá covering the studio premises; structural load and electrical safety verification for the office floor; occupational health and workplace-hygiene clearance under the Ministerio de Salud and the Ministerio de Trabajo; civil-protection filing with SINAPROC for low-occupancy office use.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance (Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas); e-portal: Sede Electrónica — https://dgi.mef.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Panamanian S.A.: (1) Notarize and register the by-laws with the Public Registry; (2) obtain an electronic signature (Firma Electrónica) for the Sede Electrónica from a licensed certification authority; (3) file the DGI Form 'Solicitud de Inscripción del Contribuyente (RUC)' together with the registered by-laws, power of attorney of the resident legal representative, and proof of local address; (4) obtain the provisional RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) and then the definitive RUC; (5) activate all obligations: Income Tax (ISR), ITBMS, and withholding taxes; (6) request activation as an 'Emisor Electrónico' for the mandatory e-invoicing system, which is completed through the DGI Sede Electrónica API platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box exists; each S.A. treated as autonomous corporate taxpayer under the territorial system. Available elections: (i) Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007 with special ISR/ITBMS exemptions on offshore service income; (ii) Panama Pacifico Special Economic Zone benefits under Law 41 of 2004; (iii) simplified 'Small Taxpayer' regime for gross income up to USD 36,000; (iv) no hybrid mismatch elections recognized; Panama applies OECD-BEPS minimum substance requirements, including the annual Economic Substance Declaration (Form 3770).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS — Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (VAT-type transaction tax, Law 43 of 1997)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: B/.36,000 (USD 36,000) in annual gross taxable income for services and digital services; sellers of goods must register irrespective of turnover; executive decrees and DGI regulations govern the threshold and digital services nexus
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturación Electrónica en Línea (FEL); phased implementation from 2021 for taxpayers with annual income above B/.300,000, extended to all ITBMS registrants by January 1, 2023; requires a digital certificate, DGI pre-authorization of the XML invoice schema, real-time or near-real-time API transmission to the DGI Sede Electrónica, and mandatory QR code, unique correlative number, and digital stamp (sello electrónico) on issued documents

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% ITBMS applies to (i) physical exports of goods leaving the Panamanian customs territory and (ii) export of services to non-residents effectively used, exploited, or consumed outside Panama (territoriality principle under DGI Resolution No. 201-2522). AI subtitle transcription and voice-cloning services delivered from Panama to foreign production houses qualify as exported services when the foreign recipient has no Panamanian establishment, the service contract identifies foreign benefit and use, and the consideration is paid from abroad; input ITBMS may be recovered via DGI-issued credit certificate or offset against other taxes.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA — Declaración Única Aduanera) filed in the SIUCA/SiCEA customs system
Bill of Lading (maritime) or Airway Bill (AWB) evidencing physical export movement
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit confirmation evidencing foreign-currency payment
Commercial Invoice and signed service contract or purchase order containing offshore-use clauses
Certificate of Origin (optional, applicable when claiming tariff preferences)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI customs and substantive audits re-verify physical exit of goods and economic benefit outside Panama for services. Adverse findings trigger: (i) retrospective ITBMS clawback with monthly interest of 1.5% under Código Fiscal Articles 685/687; (ii) administrative fines of 100% to 300% of the omitted tax for false zero-rating declarations; (iii) criminal liability for tax evasion under Law 8 of 2010; (iv) RUC suspension and cancellation of exporter/refund program status; (v) mandatory reimbursement of refunded credit certificates with surcharges.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) – the sole banking and financial regulator; there is no autonomous central bank, and the U.S. dollar is the official legal tender under Panamanian dollarization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility exists without exchange controls. Foreign-owned entities may freely remit profits, dividends, and capital proceeds, subject only to territorial-source income tax assessment. No prior approval or conversion mandate applies as USD is the domestic currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds. All export receipts may be retained or disposed of freely in USD or any convertible foreign currency; there is no timeline or ratio imposed on exporters.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High from a transactional perspective. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise and Stripe are not licensed as banks in Panama and may not hold client deposits; they act as payment processors and e-money proxies. Viability is confirmed solely as an ancillary collection/disbursement layer, while all treasury functions must be anchored in a licensed Panamanian bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a low-risk corporate client, remote onboarding with video-recorded KYC interviews is permitted by most tier-1 banks, conditioned on apostilled corporate records and notarized passport copies. At least one director or aPanamanian legal counsel must be available for an in-person interview at the discretion of the SBP-compliant compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder opacity or nominee arrangements concealing ultimate beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide notarized register of shareholders, nominee declaration in statutory form, sworn UBO statement, passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, and an active registered-agent certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreseeable transactional size inconsistent with the declared post-production subtitle and AI-cloning profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit signed international service contracts, detailed project pipeline, vendor invoices, independent audit trail of platform settlements, and a twelve-month cash-flow forecast tied to verifiable ISIC 5912 activities.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multicurrency or high-volume receipts via digital payment platforms (Stripe, Wise) triggering indirect fund flow concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present payment platform settlement statements, merchant account metadata, systematic reconciliation of each receipt to customer invoices, and PCI/PSP compliance certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived exposure to sensitive export controls or sanctions through AI-related technology purchases.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Include supplier KYC documentation, OFAC/FATF sanctions screening reports, export-control licenses for computing hardware, and contractual end-use declarations from all counterparties.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Employ SWIFT MT103 messages using the corporate BIC of the Panama S.A., with the purpose narrative 'Capital Contribution – Equity Injection'. Attach the shareholders' capital call resolution, board minutes authorizing the bank account, and the SBP-mandated beneficiary identification details. Panama maintains no capital controls, enabling direct wire clearance to a domestic operational account without exchange-rate conversion.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For subtitle-processing subcontracts and AI platform licensing, use SWIFT MT103 wires to non-resident payees; for capital-intensive hardware procurement, issue an irrevocable commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) through a Panamanian issuing bank. Low-value software subscriptions and royalty payments may be cleared via business ACH rails or card networks where accepted, with full AML audit trails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Cross-currency swaps for JPY-denominated AI licensing fees
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) hedges for Latin American receiving currencies
Commodity-linked swaps if revenue is derived in commodity-dependent market pairs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Única Anual) payment and receipt
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, through the E-Tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for existing S.A. entities; newly incorporated entities must pay the first annual tax within three months of incorporation if incorporation occurs after 30 June.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a 10% surcharge plus monthly interest of 1%; continued non-payment prevents issuance of the Paz y Salvo tax clearance, blocks share transfers, and ultimately leads to administrative strike-off of the S.A. from the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) including territorial-source income and informative financial schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A., no later than 31 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing is subject to a penalty of 5% of tax due per month or fraction thereof, up to 50%, plus 1% monthly interest; even nil filers incur fixed administrative fines if the return is submitted after the due date.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Municipal Business License Renewal (Aviso de Operación) - required only if the S.A. operates a fixed place of business or performs locally sourced economic activity in Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal authority of the district where the business premises are located (e.g., Municipio de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for existing operations; newly commenced operations must obtain the Aviso de Operación before opening.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew results in municipal fines, temporary closure of the unlicensed establishment, and loss of municipal operating permits; it does not cause corporate strike-off for a purely offshore or remote S.A.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Shareholding/UBO Register Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry and the licensed Registered Agent of the corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual UBO confirmation no later than 31 January following the calendar year; shareholding transfers must be reported to the registered agent and DGI within 15 business days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance exposes the S.A. and its legal representative to administrative fines under Panama's beneficial ownership legislation, including per-diem penalties; repeated breach may prevent issuance of certificates of good standing and may trigger suspension of corporate registrations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent audit is required where the S.A.'s annual gross income exceeds US$3,000,000 or total assets exceed US$1,000,000; additionally, DGI may require audited financial statements as supporting information in structured tax-return schedules where Panama-source revenues are material.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board and adopted in Panama as Normas Internacionales de Información Financiera (NIIF); small and medium entities may apply the IFRS for SMEs framework when applicable size criteria are met.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A. must file a beneficial-ownership notice with the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry and must maintain a confidential UBO file at the registered agent's offices. The UBO file must identify each individual owning, controlling, or ultimately receiving 10% or more of the capital or voting rights. Any transfer of shares must be recorded in the share register and reflected in the UBO filing within fifteen business days. An annual written confirmation of the UBO schedule, signed by the registered agent, is due by 31 January following each calendar year, even if no ownership change has occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Officers (Registro de Directores y Oficiales)
Share Transfer and Pledge Register (Libro de Registro de Acciones y Prendas)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas) covering annual general meeting and board meeting minutes

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$5,000–US$15,000 per audit engagement, incurred only when the statutory audit threshold is exceeded

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation regime: 100% exemption for non-Panamanian-source income, including AI subtitle transcription and voice cloning revenue from US/EU clients. Standard Panamanian S.A. has no general statutory tax holiday; special regimes (e.g., Panama-Pacifico, SEM) may apply if separately registered.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 111 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta de Personas Jurídicas) / DGI e-Tax 2.0 portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after closure of fiscal year; for calendar-year entities, due March 31 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only revenue from Panama-situs clients or services performed in Panama; if all clients are foreign, enter zero.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt and non-taxable income, including foreign-source revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare offshore subtitle/voice-licensing income here to invoke territorial exemption; retain contracts and revenue trace evidence.
Only expenses directly attributable to Panamanian-source income are fully deductible; allocate foreign costs conservatively.
For a fully territorial S.A. with no Panama-source revenue, this box must be zero.
Apply 25% to Box 4; if Box 4 is zero, no tax is payable.
Claim Panamanian client withholdings; foreign corporate income taxes are not creditable under Panama territorial law.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 10% of the tax due (minimum B/. 50); late payment surcharge of 1.5% monthly interest; zero-tax returns filed late incur a flat fine of B/. 100; repeated violation may trigger administrative closure, revocation of municipal operating license, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed out of Panamanian-source profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Request a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from the foreign shareholder's revenue authority, apostille/legalize the TRC, submit it to the Panamanian company before dividend payment, file the applicable withholding form in the DGI e-Tax portal, and retain a sworn statement of beneficial ownership. Reduced rates apply only under an in-force Panama DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and technical service fees from Panama-situs use: statutory 12.5% withholding; treaty rates commonly reduced to 10%. Interest: statutory 0% withholding on bona fide commercial loans from non-residents; related-party interest remains subject to TP recharacterization and may be deemed Panamanian-source if the lender carries on activity in Panama.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File where controlled transactions exceed USD 1,000,000 (B/. 1,000,000); Master File required when the Panamanian taxpayer forms part of an MNE group with consolidated revenue exceeding USD 50,000,000, or upon specific DGI request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama ESR (Law 123 of 2020 and subsequent regulations) is applicable to Panamanian S.A.s performing 'relevant activities', expressly including intellectual property holding, financing, distribution, and service companies. An AI subtitling/voice-cloning studio generating IP royalties must maintain real staff, premises, and core income-generating operations in Panama; failure to do so causes the entity to be treated as a shell, with income reclassified as Panamanian-source.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Under-declaring or misclassifying Panamanian-source licensing revenue as foreign-source while management and contracts are in Panama; inflating deductions with personal expenses; filing grossly inaccurate Form 111.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fiscal Code criminal sanctions: fine of 50% to 10x the evaded tax, plus 1.5% monthly interest; administrative closure of the taxpayer's establishment; loss of fiscal credits and permits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign false declarations are personally liable for evasion; criminal fiscal penalties include imprisonment of 1 to 5 years, travel bans, and freezing of personal and real estate assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a letterbox S.A. with no physical office, no local payroll, and passive registration of AI voice-cloning IP ownership without exercising substantive business activity in Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Panama ESR, failure to file the annual economic substance report or failure to prove substance attracts fines from B/. 10,000 to B/. 100,000; DGI may disregard the entity and assess tax retroactively on the reclassified Panamanian-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and shadow managers can be jointly and severally liable for fines and assessed taxes; the Superintendencia of Non-Financial Subjects may order cancellation of the corporate registration and prohibit the individual from holding director positions in Panama.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's-length management fees, voice dubbing licensing fees, or marketing intangibles to a Panamanian entity in order to shift profits out of Panama; failure to prepare contemporaneous TP documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI primary adjustment plus 10% surcharge on under-declared tax and monthly interest of 1.5%; administrative fine of up to B/. 5,000 for each missing TP document; if the adjustment is fraudulent, criminal tax penalties apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the TP transaction is a sham, the directors who signed intercompany agreements and expense vouchers can be held personally liable for the underpaid tax and interest; criminal liability arises upon proof of intentional misrepresentation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Stripe/Wise payments from multiple foreign jurisdictions on behalf of undisclosed UBOs; failing to complete DGI Developer form, to register the legal owner, or to file required Panamanian Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) suspicious transaction reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama AML Law 2020 sanctions for non-financial entities range from B/. 100,000 to B/. 5,000,000; loss of banking relations; administrative dissolution; referral to the Public Ministry for money-laundering cases punishable by up to 10 years imprisonment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly conceal UBOs or process proceeds of criminal conduct face criminal prosecution, personal asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment; civil liability for damages incurred by third parties may also attach.
